This section provides comprehensive examples for using the NoCoDB API across all versions.

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v1/transformation" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Sales Data Transformation", "description": "Transform sales data from CSV to structured format", "sourceTable": "raw_sales", "targetTable": "processed_sales", "transformationRules": [ { "sourceColumn": "date", "targetColumn": "sale_date", "transformation": "DATE_PARSE" }, { "sourceColumn": "amount", "targetColumn": "sale_amount", "transformation": "TO_DECIMAL" } ] }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v1/widgets" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Monthly Sales Chart", "type": "CHART", "config": { "chartType": "LINE", "dataSource": "sales_table", "xAxis": "month", "yAxis": "total_sales", "title": "Monthly Sales Trend" } }'
curl -X POST "noCo/api/v1/file/upload/csv" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -F "file=@sales_data.csv" \ -F "tableName=sales_data" \ -F "description=Monthly sales data for 2024"

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v1/tables/webhooks" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Sales Alert Webhook", "url": "https://api.example.com/webhooks/sales", "events": ["CREATE", "UPDATE"], "tableId": "sales_table", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer webhook_token" }, "active": true }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v2/workspaces" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Sales Analytics Workspace", "description": "Workspace for sales analytics and reporting", "visibility": "PRIVATE", "settings": { "allowPublicAccess": false, "enableCollaboration": true } }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v2/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tables" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "tableName": "Customer Data", "description": "Customer information and demographics", "columns": [ { "name": "customer_id", "type": "STRING", "primaryKey": true }, { "name": "customer_name", "type": "STRING", "required": true }, { "name": "email", "type": "STRING", "unique": true }, { "name": "registration_date", "type": "DATE" } ] }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v2/workspaces/{workspaceId}/tables/{tableId}/rows/bulk" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '[ { "customer_id": "CUST001", "customer_name": "John Doe", "email": "john.doe@example.com", "registration_date": "2024-01-15" }, { "customer_id": "CUST002", "customer_name": "Jane Smith", "email": "jane.smith@example.com", "registration_date": "2024-01-16" }, { "customer_id": "CUST003", "customer_name": "Bob Johnson", "email": "bob.johnson@example.com", "registration_date": "2024-01-17" } ]'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v2/workspaces/{workspaceId}/biPage" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Sales Dashboard", "description": "Comprehensive sales analytics dashboard", "layout": "GRID", "config": { "columns": 12, "rows": 8, "theme": "light" } }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v2/workspaces/{workspaceId}/bulkUsers" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "users": [ { "email": "analyst1@example.com", "role": "EDITOR" }, { "email": "viewer1@example.com", "role": "VIEWER" } ], "sendInvite": true, "message": "You have been invited to join the Sales Analytics workspace." }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v2/workspaces/{workspaceId}/workflow" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Daily Sales Report", "description": "Generate daily sales report automatically", "schedule": { "type": "CRON", "expression": "0 6 * * *" }, "steps": [ { "name": "Extract Sales Data", "type": "QUERY", "config": { "query": "SELECT * FROM sales WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE" } }, { "name": "Generate Report", "type": "REPORT", "config": { "template": "daily_sales_report", "format": "PDF" } }, { "name": "Send Email", "type": "EMAIL", "config": { "recipients": ["sales@example.com"], "subject": "Daily Sales Report", "body": "Please find attached the daily sales report." } } ] }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v3/workspaces/{workspaceId}/bi" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Advanced Sales Analytics", "description": "Advanced BI configuration for sales analytics", "settings": { "autoRefresh": true, "refreshInterval": 300, "theme": "dark", "timezone": "UTC" } }'

curl -X POST "noCo/api/v3/workspaces/{workspaceId}/bi/{biId}/interfaces" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "Executive Dashboard", "description": "High-level executive dashboard", "type": "DASHBOARD", "config": { "theme": "corporate", "layout": "responsive", "navigation": "sidebar", "filters": { "global": true, "persistent": true } } }'

class NoCoDBClient { constructor(baseUrl, token) { this.baseUrl = baseUrl; this.token = token; this.headers = { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; } async createWorkspace(workspaceData) { const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces`, { method: 'POST', headers: this.headers, body: JSON.stringify(workspaceData) }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to create workspace: ${response.statusText}`); } return await response.json(); } async createTable(workspaceId, tableData) { const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces/${workspaceId}/tables`, { method: 'POST', headers: this.headers, body: JSON.stringify(tableData) }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to create table: ${response.statusText}`); } return await response.json(); } async addRows(workspaceId, tableId, rows) { const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces/${workspaceId}/tables/${tableId}/rows/bulk`, { method: 'POST', headers: this.headers, body: JSON.stringify(rows) }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to add rows: ${response.statusText}`); } return await response.json(); } async getTables(workspaceId, page = 0, size = 20) { const response = await fetch( `${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces/${workspaceId}/tables?page=${page}&size=${size}`, { headers: this.headers } ); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to get tables: ${response.statusText}`); } return await response.json(); } async updateTable(workspaceId, tableId, tableData) { const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces/${workspaceId}/tables/${tableId}`, { method: 'PUT', headers: this.headers, body: JSON.stringify(tableData) }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to update table: ${response.statusText}`); } return await response.json(); } async deleteTable(workspaceId, tableId) { const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces/${workspaceId}/tables/${tableId}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: this.headers }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to delete table: ${response.statusText}`); } return response.ok; } async createBIPage(workspaceId, pageData) { const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/noCo/api/v2/workspaces/${workspaceId}/biPage`, { method: 'POST', headers: this.headers, body: JSON.stringify(pageData) }); async function handleAPIError(response) { if (!response.ok) { const errorData = await response.json(); switch (response.status) { case 400: throw new Error(`Bad Request: ${errorData.message}`); case 401: throw new Error('Unauthorized: Please check your authentication'); case 403: throw new Error('Forbidden: Insufficient permissions'); case 404: throw new Error('Not Found: Resource not found'); case 409: throw new Error(`Conflict: ${errorData.message}`); case 429: throw new Error('Rate Limited: Please try again later'); default: throw new Error(`Server Error: ${errorData.message}`); } } } // Usage in API calls async function createWorkspace(workspaceData) { try { const response = await fetch('/noCo/api/v2/workspaces', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(workspaceData) }); await handleAPIError(response); return await response.json(); } catch (error) { console.error('Error creating workspace:', error); throw error; } }

import requests from typing import Dict, Any def handle_api_error(response: requests.Response) -> None: """Handle API errors with proper exception handling""" if not response.ok: try: error_data = response.json() error_message = error_data.get('message', 'Unknown error') except: error_message = response.text if response.status_code == 400: raise ValueError(f"Bad Request: {error_message}") elif response.status_code == 401: raise ValueError("Unauthorized: Please check your authentication") elif response.status_code == 403: raise ValueError("Forbidden: Insufficient permissions") elif response.status_code == 404: raise ValueError("Not Found: Resource not found") elif response.status_code == 409: raise ValueError(f"Conflict: {error_message}") elif response.status_code == 429: raise ValueError("Rate Limited: Please try again later") else: raise RuntimeError(f"Server Error: {error_message}") # Usage in API calls def create_workspace(workspace_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Create workspace with error handling""" try: response = requests.post( '/noCo/api/v2/workspaces', headers={ 'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, json=workspace_data ) handle_api_error(response) return response.json() except Exception as e: print(f"Error creating workspace: {e}") raise
